verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. Lean never changes variable: it keeps the paper's (5.11) form in R, moments n u e omega 4 = ∫_{R>0} (R Σ_{i+j=n} U_iU_j - (R²/2) ∂_RΠ_n) dR. Unfolding pressureGradient turns that density into R · (Σ_{i+j=n} U_iU_j - ½ Σ_{i+j=n} E_iE_j + ½ Ω_{n-1}), which is exactly R times the paper's X-integrand here; since X = R²/2 gives dX = R dR, the Lean integral and the displayed X-integral are the same number. Constants, signs and the convolution ranges agree: PositiveAxisSystem.convolution n F = Σ_{i=0}^{n} F i (n-i), i.e. the full i+j=n sum on both the U and the E term, and Lean's omega is instantiated in GlobalSlowProfiles.profiles_moments as R²/2 · (Ω_{n-1}/X), i.e. Ω_{n-1} itself.
